event OfferCreated(uint256 indexed id, uint8 kind, address indexed donor, address indexed to, uint256 principal, uint256 nonce)
event SaleOpened(uint256 indexed id, address indexed donor, uint256 slicesPerRecord, uint256 records, bytes32 salt, uint256 nonce)
event RecordsSynced(uint256 indexed id, address indexed seller, uint256 records, uint256 slices, uint256 earnedOfferId, uint256 earnedHeld, uint256 nonce)
event SaleFilled(uint256 indexed id, address indexed lastSeller, uint256 nonce)
event AllowanceUpdated(address indexed user, uint256 totalProduced, uint256 totalRedeemed, uint256 nonce)
event OfferTransferred(uint256 indexed id, address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 nonce)
event OfferSplit(uint256 indexed id, uint256 indexed newId, uint256 slices, uint256 nonce)
event OfferRedeemed(uint256 indexed id, address indexed donor, address indexed holder, uint256 principal, uint256 nonce)
event OfferSwept(uint256 indexed id, address indexed donor, address indexed holder, uint256 principal, address sweeper, uint256 nonce)
event Donation(address indexed from, uint256 amount)
event CreditsFormed(address indexed user, uint256 formed, uint256 credits)
event CreditRedeemed(address indexed user, uint256 creditsSpent, uint256 ethPaid, uint256 nonce)
event GateFlagged(uint256 indexed id, bool flagged)
event Staked(address indexed user, uint64 atBlock)
event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)
function createOfferS(address to, uint256 delayBlocks, uint256 expectedNonce) payable
function createOfferGated(address to, uint256 delayBlocks, bytes32 pinCommitment_, uint256 expectedNonce) payable
function createOfferA(uint256 delayBlocks, uint256 slicesPerRecord, uint256 expectedNonce) payable
function createOfferB(address to, uint256 delayBlocks, uint256 slicesPerRecord, uint256 expectedNonce) payable
function syncRecords(uint256 id, uint256 n, uint256 expectedNonce) returns (uint256 taken)
function transferOffer(uint256 id, address to, uint256 expectedNonce)
function transferSlices(uint256 id, uint256 slices, address to, uint256 expectedNonce)
function redeemOffer(uint256 id, bytes32 pin, uint256 expectedNonce)
function redeemSlices(uint256 id, uint256 slices, bytes32 pin, uint256 expectedNonce)
function offers(uint256 id) view returns (address donor, address holder, uint256 principal, bool active, uint8 kind, uint64 createdAt, uint64 sweepableAt, uint256 count)

function sales(uint256 id) view returns (address donor, address target, uint8 kind, bool active, uint256 slicesLeft, uint256 slicesPerRecord, uint256 recordsLeft, uint64 createdAt, uint64 sweepableAt, bytes32 salt)
function recordPayloadHash(uint256 id, address seller, uint256 index) view returns (bytes32)
function redeemPayloadHash(address user, uint8 kind, uint256 amount) view returns (bytes32)
function sweepableOffers(address holder) view returns (uint256[] ids)
function transfer(address to, uint256 n) returns (bool)
